'''Bantha graveyard''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It shared its name<ref name="Tatooine with Luke Skywalker" /> with a [[Bantha Graveyard (Roon)|site]] on the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="DB Mungo">{{DB|character|mungobaobab|Baobab, Mungo}}</ref>
